period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot, but on a CONSOLIDATED basis (Social Islami Bank and its two subsidiaries, SIBL Securities Limited and SIBL Investment Limited) -- SIBL's own quarterly/half-yearly filing for this period presents ONLY a Consolidated Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account, with no separate Solo/Standalone statement shown at all. This is a genuine basis difference in the source document itself (not a choice made by this dataset) from the main Q4/annual series, which is Solo throughout; flagged explicitly per this project's 'prefer Solo, explicitly flag when only Consolidated is available' convention. SIBL began presenting a separate Solo statement alongside the Consolidated one starting with its 2016 Q2 (Half-Yearly) filing (2017 Q1 is a one-off reversion to Consolidated-only).  Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2014 (Jan-1 through the end of this quarter), not discrete-quarter figures, per this project's convention (flagged via the _cumulative suffix, matching bank_financials/CITYBANK/quarterly/2024_Q1.json). Shariah-based Islamic bank: 'Investments' is the Shariah-compliant equivalent of conventional Loans and Advances; 'Profit paid on Deposits' is the equivalent of Interest Expense; 'Net Investment Income' is the equivalent of Net Interest Income -- consistent with the convention already used for this bank's Q4/annual series. Classified-investment (asset-quality/NPL) and Capital Adequacy (CRAR/Tier-1/Tier-2) figures are NOT disclosed in SIBL's interim quarterly/half-yearly filings at all (confirmed absent from every quarter's notes checked in this pass) -- this is a genuine limitation of the source documents themselves, not an extraction gap, so no classified_investments/npl_pct/car_pct/tier1/tier2/RWA fields are populated for any Q1-Q3 period in this dataset.
